# anthropic_spend_limit_increase_requests (Data Source)

Lists members' requests for a higher spend limit in a Claude Enterprise organization. Approving or denying is a one-shot action outside Terraform. Requires `enterprise_api_key` with `read:spend_limits`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_spend_limit_increase_requests" "pending" {
  statuses = ["pending"]
}

output "pending_requesters" {
  value = [for r in data.anthropic_spend_limit_increase_requests.pending.requests : r.actor_email]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `actor_ids` (List of String) Restrict to requests made by these user ids.
- `statuses` (List of String) Restrict to these statuses (`pending`, `approved`, `denied`).

### Read-Only

- `requests` (Attributes List) Increase requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requests))

<a id="nestedatt--requests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requests`

Read-Only:

- `actor_email` (String) Email of the requesting user; null when unavailable.
- `actor_name` (String) Name of the requesting user; null when unavailable.
- `actor_user_id` (String) Id of the requesting user.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `currency` (String) Currency of the spend summary; null after resolution.
- `current_amount` (String) Current effective cap in minor units (cents) at request time; null when unlimited or after resolution.
- `id` (String) Request id (`slir_...`).
- `period` (String) `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.
- `period_to_date_spend` (String) Spend so far in the period at request time; null after resolution.
- `resolved_at` (String) Resolution timestamp; null while pending.
- `resolved_by_id` (String) User id or scoped API key id of the resolver; null while pending.
- `resolved_by_type` (String) `user_actor` or `scoped_api_key_actor`; null while pending.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `approved` or `denied`.
